global_thought_scope: Public assistant pilot drawn from the Perspective Beyond atlas.

cross_cluster_edges.reading: JUBAP's propagation logic can be made operational through evidence that the receiving organization can repeat the practice and handle new exceptions after the team leaves.
cross_cluster_edges.boundary: No garantía de autosostenibilidad ni obligación de que toda práctica quede completamente documentada.

cross_cluster_edges.reading: The network example suggests a JUBAP leverage point in the funding and transfer rule itself: make the contributing node sustainable so the wider service can work.
cross_cluster_edges.boundary: Es aplicación propuesta de la lectura; no implica que JUBAP diseñara la reforma histórica de Barcelona.

cross_cluster_edges.reading: For a complementary reading, see [A Texas-to-Mexico Tiger Team deployment](https://jubap.us/case-study-texas-to-mexico-oilfield-services-transformation-knowledge-transfer-industrialization-and-compliance/).
Compressed accountability should not become concentrated blame without matching authority or visible contribution.
cross_cluster_edges.boundary: La similitud no demuestra que ese patrón exista en un contrato concreto ni traduce una aplicación directamente a una persona.

cross_cluster_edges.reading: Cross-border knowledge transfer includes the ability to handle local exceptions, not merely the movement of manuals or personnel.
cross_cluster_edges.boundary: El relato no constituye una medición del efecto económico de la migración ni de una transferencia completa.

cross_cluster_edges.reading: The transfer-compensation example shows why network value may require funding the contributing node even when its local ledger understates the benefit it creates elsewhere.
cross_cluster_edges.boundary: La analogía no verifica cifras históricas del fondo ni prueba que toda línea deficitaria cree valor neto para la red.

cross_cluster_edges.reading: The four-series programme can supply distinct diagnostic questions for reading JUBAP in the field without treating their convergence as four independent validations of the framework.
cross_cluster_edges.boundary: La práctica histórica no deriva de publicaciones posteriores; convergencia conceptual y contraste empírico se mantienen separados.

cross_cluster_edges.reading: For a complementary reading, see [Surviving Capability: the field-to-theory bridge](https://jubap.us/surviving-capability-why-the-field-celebrates-what-the-theory-condemns/).
